title: LU 1995TS Refurbished
description: Retextured the Handrails and the Open Buttons and fully removed the logo.
body: Retextured the Handrails and the Open Buttons and removed the logo. The 1995 Stock (1995TS) of the London Underground, which operates on the Northern line, underwent a major refurbishment program between 2013 and 2015. Carried out by Alstom, this refurbishment aimed to modernize the trains, which were introduced in the late 1990s. Original: Jonathanho33
